CustomField.description: Also enforce this rule when a record is created directly with To_Value__c, so nobody can skip the requirements by creating a record at the final stage. Only applies to rules with a blank From_Value__c, and the trigger must call FieldTransitionValidator in before insert too. Child-record conditions can't be met on insert, since the record has no children yet.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Also check this rule when a record is created directly with To Value. Needs a blank From Value and a before insert trigger.
CustomField.label: Apply On Insert
